gloss: to lean back; to bend backward

definitions.gloss: to lean back; to bend backward
definitions.explanation: To tilt one's body backward, often in surprise, to avoid something, or to look up.

examples.japanese: {驚|おどろ}いて{思|おも}わず{仰|の}け{反|ぞ}った。
examples.english: I involuntarily leaned back in surprise.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}に{座|すわ}って{大|おお}きく{仰|の}け{反|ぞ}る。
examples.english: To lean far back in a chair.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}のパンチを{仰|の}け{反|ぞ}って{避|よ}けた。
examples.english: I dodged his punch by leaning back.

notes:
{仰|の}け{反|ぞ}る describes the action of bending or leaning backward. It often implies a sudden or reactive movement.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
- {仰|の}け{反|ぞ}る (dictionary form)
- {仰|の}け{反|ぞ}らない (negative)
- {仰|の}け{反|ぞ}った (past)
- {仰|の}け{反|ぞ}って (te-form)

USAGE NOTE:
Often used to describe reactions to surprise, shock, or physical impact.
